analogy.rationale: The annotated targets are predominantly gap-junction connexins (GJA/GJB) and ABC transporters (ABCC1, P-glycoprotein) rather than classical ligand-gated chloride channels, and these cell lines express little of the canonical chloride channel machinery, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other transporter/channel blockers with overlapping ABC or ion-channel targets.
